title: Token mint scope format regression — comma vs space
description: The token mint CLI command keeps reverting to comma-separated scopes (read,write,follow) despite being fixed to space-separated earlier. The scope checker splits on whitespace OR comma (fixed), but the default_value in cli.rs may have been overwritten during a refactoring round. Check all three servers.
close_reason: Not a regression — scope format fix is in place (default_value='read write follow', checker handles both). The earlier test failures were caused by zombie processes holding ports, not scope issues.
